## Summary

7.4: `sofar drive --detach` survives a slow lane setup. packages/engine/src/cli/drive.ts: detachedStartNotifier sends with a callback and catches a throwing send, so a caller already gone no longer kills the driver with write EPIPE. runDriveDetached polls the child's log, and each lane line (created at / setting up — / set up in) restarts the start window.
